question.text: For how many years is market making compulsory after listing on an SME exchange?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per p.233-p.234, lead managers must ensure compulsory market making for a minimum of 3 years from the date of listing on the SME exchange or migration from the Main Board. The Trap: 1, 2 or 5 years do not match the 3-year minimum market-making obligation prescribed in the source. Note: The market maker is required to maintain an inventory of at least 5% of the specified securities allotted/offered as part of the market-making obligation.
